name: ncc-workflow
description: Novel Create Center：长篇网文从立书到收束的工作流。下限引擎——书魂与类型契约、五层决策、三本账（承诺/知情/世界）、读者此刻、水章判据、硬伤审；上限引擎——作者种子、人物引擎、场景卡先审故事后写文字、写作简报与质检清单分离、关键节拍写多版由作者挑、三层评价（不打绝对分）、发展编辑、三种写作模式。循环与收束——单元、卷、书三级复盘，卷间闸与完本闸，读者数据回流校准模拟读者，作者可持续与团队认领。每个决策点给推荐与备选，推荐从作者种子长出来。底蕴层——24 张底蕴卡，场景需要时按需派考据顾问出本章知识点清单，有据不编。素材层——作者随手记的生活素材在合适的场景送进写手包，作者自有的代入感与规避点经验进判据，小说底盘作设定底料，拆书拆出质感与机制样本。学习与嗓音层——作者旧文定文风指纹与文风基准，读者画像分别盲评并合成弃读热力，偏好随时间衰减、否决降权，完本经验进技艺库并回灌下一本书。评测与交付——锚定章回归测审稿的检出率与稳定性，同一写手包盲评横评模型，多书仪表盘与承诺热力图，合稿与 EPUB 导出。记忆与进化——每个角色有本书记忆与跨书记忆（同类证据两处才生效、久不出现自动归档），作者在会话里的话记成交接卡按角色切片派给子代理（审稿与试读读者不拿），全文检索。设定类目——门派、种族、血脉、企业等按题材研判，表里没有的可新提。拆书学法——拆完一段写技法卡（大局、剧情、爽点、暗线、情绪、人物、设定、文笔），按角色挑卡、用后结算好坏；对标基线进复盘。自进化分四档：记忆自动，规则改动先过锚定章回归再由作者确认，可撤回。按信息架构七律组织（一事一源、副本只能生成、一处一主、按变化内聚、只经接口耦合、现状与历史分开、按需可见）。经理窗口调度十一个创作角色，book.json 单一状态源，写-审-改分离。

description_i18n.en: Novel Create Center: a long-form web-novel workflow from founding to finale. Floor engine — book soul and genre contract, five decision layers, three ledgers (promises / knowledge states / world), reader-now, water-chapter detection, hard-defect review. Ceiling engine — author seeds, character engine, scene cards reviewed for story before any prose, writing briefs kept separate from review checklists, key beats written in several versions for the author to pick, three-layer evaluation with no absolute quality scores, a developmental editor, and architect / gardener / hybrid writing modes. Loops and finale — unit, volume and whole-book reviews, volume and finale gates, real reader data calibrating the simulated reader, author sustainability and team roles. Every decision point offers a recommendation grown from the author's own seeds. Knowledge layer — 24 domain cards and an on-demand knowledge adviser that writes sourced, chapter-specific knowledge lists when scenes need them. Material layer — the author's own observations reach the scenes that need them; the author's notes on immersion and common pitfalls become review criteria; the author's setting base seeds the power system; deconstruction yields texture and social-mechanism samples. Learning and voice layer — a style fingerprint and anchor from the author's own writing, persona-based blind reads merged into a drop-off heat map, preferences that decay and remember rejections, and a craft library that feeds the next book. Evaluation and delivery — anchor-chapter regression for review detection and stability, blind model comparison on a frozen writer pack, a multi-book dashboard with promise heat maps, and merged or EPUB export. Memory and evolution — every role keeps book and cross-book memory (two pieces of evidence before a lesson counts, stale entries archived), the author's words in session become handoff cards sliced per role for subagents (reviewers and the blind reader get none), full-text recall. Setting categories — sects, races, bloodlines, companies and more chosen per genre, new ones proposed when none fits. Learning from deconstruction — technique cards on overall design, plot, payoffs, hidden lines, emotion, character, setting and prose, matched per role and settled by results; benchmark baselines in reviews. Self-evolution in four tiers: memory is automatic; rule changes pass anchor-chapter regression and author approval, and can be reverted. Organized by seven information-architecture laws: one source per fact, copies only generated, one writer per file, cohesion by reason to change, coupling only through interfaces, state separate from history, need-to-know views. A manager window dispatches eleven creative roles over a single book.json state source, with write/review/revise separated.
